name: finman
description: Personal finance tracker. Scripts here run the API and web app together, or the Docker stack.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
